description: Control of the round-7 rule: an imported runner name that starts with `__` (`from pytest import skip as __omit__`) is never certain, whatever the file does with it: Python binds and mangles such names on its own (`__class__`, `__classdict__`, `__type_params__`, `__x` in a class), today and in versions to come. TG003 warns that `__omit__("x")` may skip `test_adds`, never FAIL. The real runner skips it.
